segments.name: Fiber Lasers
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells fiber lasers, laser and non-laser systems, fiber amplifiers and related optical components for OEMs, system integrators and end users worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one segment which involves the design, development, production and distribution of fiber lasers, laser and non-laser systems, fiber amplifiers, and related optical components.

revenueModel.text: Customers including OEMs, system integrators and end users pay for high-performance fiber lasers, amplifiers, diode lasers and laser-based systems used in materials processing, medical and advanced applications.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products globally to original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs"), system integrators and end users.
